property_summary: For any actor locking a guess at block n, settling at block n+1 must revert (target block is n+1 and settle requires block.number > target); the mutant records n as target so settle at n+1 succeeds, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Record block.number instead of block.number + 1 as the target block.
